items.title: Boeing Lands Massive 150-Plane Deal With Turkish Airlines
items.summary: Turkish Airlines Bets Big on Boeing With Up to 150 737 Max Jets

items.title: Turkish Airlines orders 150 Boeing 737 MAX jets in major new deal
items.summary: Turkish Airlines said on Wednesday it was to buy 150 jets from Boeing that would be scheduled for delivery between 2033 and 2037.View on euronews

items.title: BA Lands Turkish Airlines’ 737 MAX Deal For Up To 150 Jets — It’s Boeing’s Largest Single-Aisle Order From The Carrier
items.summary: Turkish Airlines will add 100 Boeing 737-8 aircraft to its fleet and has options for another 50 MAX jets.

items.title: New Turkish Airlines CEO Says Premium Economy Being Considered, Among Other Fleet Upgrades
items.summary: Turkish Airlines' new CEO reveals plans for new destinations, aircraft and even a new premium economy cabin on its new planes. He is bullish on the airline's growth plan.

items.title: Deucalion Aviation Arranges Acquisition of Two Airbus A330-300 Aircraft on Lease to Turkish Airlines
items.summary: Deucalion Aviation, a global aviation investment and asset management platform, today announced the addition of two Airbus A330-300 aircraft to its managed portfolio, both on lease to Turkish Airlines. Deucalion served as arranger and servicer on behalf of institutional investors. Transaction terms were not disclosed.
